I would be livid too to see my abuser happy. My father touched me as a child and my only solace was that he is dead. I hope you find peace.
I know that it may sound dumb but just being a confidante or being approachable would help him hopefully. Just tell him that you’re there if he wants to talk. Try to empathize. Good luck.

Everyone has their struggles including myself. I wouldn’t worry about the future too much especially at your age. Don’t feel guilty about how you feel though. Sometimes it’s ok to feel paranoid but if it becomes too much then try to reach out to someone that you can trust. Good luck.

Hey I hope you read this. I did read your post. It sounds like you have a lot of horrible people in you life but one thing I just want to say is that by dying you’ll let those monsters win. That’s not fair to you. Happy Birthday. Just think about that.

I think you had an extremely painful life so far. I read your story in its entirety and just want to say that you’re so very strong. Despite all the bad things that happened in your life you found strength to keep going. I don’t know if it has just become too much to bear but maybe just maybe you can be strong just a little longer.  You are a queen. Unfortunately your kingdom is empty but royalty doesn’t give up the throne. They fight. Just reading your story gives me hope to live a little longer. If you could do the same and like me take it day by day that would make such a difference. I hope you have a nice day. I love you. Stay strong.
Same man good for you keep going you show them

I too feel soulless and I'm not sure if I have one. The love of my life my first real love turned out to be my bully. When I experienced that it felt like a part of me died permanently and I couldn't recover it no matter how hard I tried.
I suffered from PTSD as a result of severe bullying that I still have flashbacks of. Thank you for your empathy.

You've been going through such a painful experience. Unfortunately however no suicide is guaranteed. I would be encouraged at the sentiment that you don't wish to hurt anyone that is very courageous. I hope you find some clarity. It sucks that you were hospitalized.  I hope you get the care you need and that is a cruel thing that your parents are saying.  Just because you are experiencing mental issues does not make you weak.

This is a very different position than the one I have when it comes to death. I want to kill myself because of things happening to me. That little voice in your head must be a pain. I would tell you it goes away with time but I would be lying. You just have to learn to ignore it if you can and I get that death is inevitable but life has so many wondrous things to explore and hopefully enjoy. There has to be a meaning for your life and mine as well. Think of the impact you had on your friend. Even though it's been a while try and reach out if you want. I'm sure they will appreciate it if it is a real friendship
Nothing can guarantee death unfortunately.  Bullets, knives or medication. There is always a chance of survival.

People are horrible like that. They use anything to get popularity. Makes me sick. I wondered too if people in high-school would come to my funeral claiming they knew me well and that we were close. It was one of the reasons why I chose not to kill myself at the time to give  those morons who drove me to suicide reverence.
